outlook.statement: The amendments (TRAI Seventh Amendment Regulations) are expected to improve transparency, reduce duplication in compliance processes and strengthen overall governance within the broadcasting distribution ecosystem.
Hathway Digital is working towards scaling the IP TV operations.

Global growth is projected to remain resilient at 3.3% in 2026 and at 3.2% in 2027. Global headline inflation is expected to decline from an estimated 4.1% in 2025 to 3.8% in 2026 and further to 3.4% in 2027. The 2026 US-Iran conflict has triggered a severe global energy security crisis, forcing oil prices upward and threatening to disrupt the global economy through supply shocks. For India, these global conditions translate into external uncertainties rather than immediate macroeconomic stress. Slower growth in key trading partners, tariff-induced disruptions to trade and volatility in capital flows could intermittently weigh on exports and investor sentiment. The domestic economy remains on a stable footing. Inflation has moderated to historically low levels, although some firming is expected to occur going forward. Balance sheets across households, firms and banks are healthier and public investment continues to support economic outreach activities. Consumption demand remains resilient, and private investment intentions are improving. These conditions provide resilience against external shocks and support the continuation of growth momentum. The cumulative impact of policy reforms over recent years appears to have lifted the economy's medium-term growth potential closer to 7%.

Indian M&E sector expected to grow 2.8% in 2026 to ₹2.86 trillion (US$32.9 billion); excluding online gaming, expected to grow at 8% in 2026 and CAGR over 7% to reach ₹3.3 trillion (US$37.9 billion) by 2028.
Digital media revenue expected to grow at CAGR of 14% to reach ₹1,640 billion by 2028.

Television households expected to cross 200 million by 2028; Connected TV homes expected to increase to 67 million by 2028; Wired broadband homes increased from 32 million to 46 million in last two years.

Company will continue to invest in network modernization, AI-led customer experience, and digital platforms to strengthen competitive positioning and capitalize on growing demand for high-speed, reliable broadband services.

Company remains cautiously optimistic about long-term prospects of Cable Television business, underpinned by operational strengths and commitment to customer satisfaction; will continue proactive engagement with TRAI, MIB, and industry stakeholders on regulatory matters.
Economic Survey projects real GDP growth in FY27 in range of 6.8% to 7.2%; outlook is steady growth amid global uncertainty, requiring caution but not pessimism.
